title: Installed commit checks name recovery without bypasses
text: Closed in source: the installed pre-commit hook checks authored-file limits and names splitting, shortening or repairing the checker. Path claims and implementation-entry status belong to live tool guards, not commit gates. Generated blocks, wake capability and rendered-agent drift are checked by CI repo contracts. The unused core hook chain and its suppression event were removed; no commit-message token grants path coverage.
